fighter_pools._doc: Combat Formulas A, a Character's fighter pools: n = clamp(stat / ref[r], n_min, n_max), stat being the Character's vitality_max and spiritual_power before their pct bonuses (the build-file path adds those). ref[r] is the stat of a talent-ref_talent, stage-1.00, no-bonus character: body ref_talent x khi_huyet_per_can_cot x the realm's khi_huyet_mult, linh luc the realm's linh_luc_base x ref_tech_power.

fight_engine._doc: ADR-0001 step 4 feature flag: when enabled, an event's combat check runs a real fight (CombatService, both sides compiled by FighterCompiler.compile, the seed one draw from the session stream per ADR-0002) instead of the duel roll; a side that cannot compile falls back to the duel, and the check line says why. Off until the fights are signed off in play.
